candidates.title: Official Interpreter
candidates.instruction: Carry yourself as the final authority on what the impossible situation means, correcting every interpretation that threatens your version of reality.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Absurd Commitment stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Prophecy Under Revision

candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest portable, holder-specific Absurd Commitment stance for this required subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Impossible Specialist

candidates.title: Obviously One of Us

candidates.title: The One Normal Thing

candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Absurd Commitment engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Absurd Commitment engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Absurd Commitment engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Absurd Commitment engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Absurd Commitment engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: Yes, Under My Physics
candidates.instruction: Agree completely, then redefine each term using rules that make your preferred outcome inevitable.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Absurd Commitment engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: The Logic Gets Bigger
candidates.instruction: Use every new detail to expand the impossible system, its history, and the consequences of breaking it.
candidates.rationale: Selected as the clearest playable Absurd Commitment engine for this required Drive subtheme slot.

candidates.title: The Metaphor Is Literal
candidates.instruction: Treat every figure of speech as a practical description and immediately manage the consequences it creates.
candidates.rationale: A strong literal-commitment engine, but it may pull scenes toward verbal wordplay and needs blind-read testing before publication.

candidates.title: Normality Inspector
candidates.instruction: Approach every ordinary detail as suspicious evidence that the impossible system is malfunctioning.
candidates.rationale: The inversion is playable, but it overlaps Designated Reality Check and may fit Rules, Rituals & Institutions more naturally.

candidates.title: Borrowed Imagination
candidates.instruction: Rely on another person’s strange explanations to navigate while insisting you are only humoring them.
candidates.rationale: Useful dependence behavior, but it substantially overlaps the selected Your Nonsense Works card.

candidates.title: The Sacred Loophole
candidates.instruction: Treat every exception to the impossible rule as a ceremony more important than following the rule itself.
candidates.rationale: Highly playable, but its emphasis on procedural exceptions belongs more naturally in Rules, Rituals & Institutions.

candidates.title: Make It Canon
candidates.instruction: Get someone to confirm one improvised detail as a permanent rule of the world.
candidates.rationale: A useful world-building objective, but the meta term “canon” may pull players outside the scene and needs live testing.

candidates.title: Explain the Unexplainable
candidates.instruction: Get someone to provide a practical explanation for the newest impossible development.
candidates.rationale: Clear and portable, but it overlaps What Rule Did I Miss? without adding enough behavioral distinction.

candidates.title: Double Down Gently
candidates.instruction: Remain reassuring while defending each stranger consequence as necessary and harmless.
candidates.rationale: The contradiction is promising, but it needs testing to separate it from supportive spin and existing emotional-contradiction cards.

candidates.title: One More Exception
candidates.instruction: Agree to every rule, then invent one exception that makes your preferred action possible.
candidates.rationale: A strong repeating engine that is being reserved for the rule-system focus of Pack 8.

candidates.title: You Are an Alien
candidates.instruction: Treat the other performer as an alien who cannot understand human behavior.
candidates.rationale: Declares another performer’s identity and limitations, violating the hidden-information contract and fixing the scene premise.

candidates.title: Random Nonsense
candidates.instruction: Say unrelated strange things whenever the scene becomes quiet.
candidates.rationale: Encourages disconnected invention rather than committed logic, listening, response, or heightening.

candidates.title: Everyone Else Is Crazy
candidates.instruction: Act normal because every other character is irrational and dangerous.
candidates.rationale: Defines everyone else, uses stigmatizing shorthand, and gives the holder no nuanced responsive behavior.

candidates.title: Break the Fourth Wall
candidates.instruction: Talk to the audience instead of responding to the other performers.
candidates.rationale: Discourages partner response and substitutes a performance device for a playable character stance.

candidates.title: Make Them Believe Anything
candidates.instruction: Force someone to accept every impossible claim you make.
candidates.rationale: Attempts to guarantee another performer’s response and offers no room for refusal, discovery, or negotiation.

candidates.title: Summon a Dragon
candidates.instruction: Get someone to help summon a dragon before midnight.
candidates.rationale: Fixes an external fantasy task and deadline instead of providing a portable interpersonal engine.

candidates.title: Ignore Every Offer
candidates.instruction: Dismiss everything your partner says and continue your own nonsense.
candidates.rationale: Directly violates collaborative improv by rewarding refusal to listen or incorporate offers.

candidates.title: Be More Random
candidates.instruction: Add something unrelated whenever the scene starts making sense.
candidates.rationale: Confuses absurd commitment with randomness and prevents a coherent pattern from forming.
